tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · Q3 2026 Paid Leave and WA Cares Report
tasks.description: Prepare the Q3 2026 Washington Paid Leave and WA Cares report for HANGS General Contracting from 8 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out the Paid Leave premium on wages up to the 2026 cap and its split between employees and employer, and the WA Cares premium on every covered wage, with the exemptions on file. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft report. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Paid Leave and WA Cares report PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.outputsPath: Outputs/HANGS General Contracting 2026-Q3 Paid Leave Report
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
